notes.title: Major Update: v1.3
notes.notes:
Dear players,

Ex Natura is on Winter Sale and we wanted to give you a New Year gift! Regarding your feedback, we have made a lot of revisions and bug fixes for Ex Natura. We have redesigned the mob positions, and item locations and added new enemies to the game. Also, we fixed a lot of bugs which reported to us.

[b]v1.3 Changelog[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new enemies: Lava Malphas: Lava Branchman, Lava Sculpt
[*] Fixed subtitle timing issues
[*] LOD Fixes
[*] Updated joystick sensitivity
[*] Localization updates on Inventory, Equipment, Warping, Alchemy, Forge menus
[*] Fixed collision bugs
[*] Player magic ability damage buffed
[*] Player stamina regen nerfed
[*] Cultist Mage attack wait time reduced
[*] Bug fixed: Enemies continue walking after the Player death
[*] Player rage buffed
[*] Mob replacements on Misty Forest, The Desert, The Dungeon, The Swamp, Snowy Mountains
[*] Updated lights at The Dungeon
[*] Added ambient music to Misty Forest, The Desert, The Dungeon, The Swamp, Snowy Mountains
[*] Bug fixed: invincibility after using Demigod's Tears
[*] Fixed alchemy and forge issues
[*] Added secret item: The Pantheon
[*] Bug fixed: Chests disappearing on interact
[*] Bug fixed: Game not starting after returning to the main menu
[*] Added DualShock layout icons on the UI
[*] Added layout icons to tutorials
[*] Added new attacks to Ghoul
[*] Added new attacks to The Banshee
[*] Updated warp menu
[*] Updated Settings menu
[*] Reduced application file size
[*] Added 4 more slots to the inventory
[*] Flameburst potion removed
[*] Spidersilk potion removed
[*] Bloodlust potion removed
[*] Added Blessing of Nature
[*] Added Blessing of Blood
[*] Bug fixed: enemies not attacking sometimes
[/list]

Merry Christmas!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41085725/d3cc25a79d18418aaf0c48ee49ac6c74cacd79b2.png[/img]

notes.title: BIG UPDATE: New Levels and 3 New Bosses
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41085725/e4dc08700624161deddef1a79633d114b8700541.png[/img]

A Message from Blackburne Games;

Hello dear players,

We are working on Ex Natura: Nature Corrupted and adding new levels, features, bosses and bug fixes
to the project. We are working hard to give you the best experience and we are ambitious to finish it soon.
While we are continiung to our development process, we also fixed some bugs and updated the game.


Ex Natura: Nature Corrupted v0.9.3 Changelog:
-Improved localizations
-Fixed options bugs
-Fixed controller bugs
-Fixed crashes
-Added level up available text
-Optimization improvements
-New Bosses: Gûlsema and Gûl
-Fixed options menu bugs
-Added new levels: The Swamp, The Misty Mountains

We will frequently update the game regarding your feedback!

Thanks!

--

What to expect from our community? 

* Meeting up with fellow cultists!
* Ex Natura : Nature Corrupted Giveaways
* Sneak Peaks from our newest creations
* News about our upcoming games
* Being a part of a great family 🙂

We wish to see you on our livestream, 👋 

You can also follow us from these links 

https://linktr.ee/Blackburne
